scope: Prove the reference workflow from a cloned checkout: git clone -> npm run setup -> npm start, owner sign-in, scoped write, fresh step-up reveal, transient clear, member grant creation, member revocation denial, restart persistence, plaintext-at-rest scan, provider outage fail-closed, and provider backup/restore with durable grant revocation (Requirement N30).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C30-owned path bytes, NUL separators and each file SHA-256; excludes docs/evidence and plans/ handoff files to avoid recursive self-reference

environment.npm: 11.17.0 (toolchain lock pins npm 11.9.0; the executing npm reports 11.17.0)
environment.host_note: Clean supported host execution: cloned from repository index git tree, fresh provider containers provisioned by the clone, zero plaintext at rest verified, provider outage fail-closed proved, and raft backup/restore with durable grant revocation validated.

fixtures.provenance: repository-authored synthetic workflow, identities and secret sentinel; matches ops/local/keycloak-realm.json and contains no real credential material

asserted: owner PKCE sign-in through the Keycloak form
HTTP 201 write at version 1 with no plaintext in the rendered page
reveal without step-up -> 401 step_up_required and no plaintext element
fresh step-up reauthentication -> 200 reveal, Cache-Control no-store, plaintext equals the fixture sentinel
dialog close clears the DOM plaintext
reopened reveal demands a new step-up and shows no cached plaintext
member listing is owner-scoped (0 of 0) and direct member reveal without grant -> 403 access_denied
owner issues scoped member grant with step-up reauthentication -> 201 created
member with active grant is authorized for reveal step-up (401) instead of 403
owner revokes member grant via Access console UI with step-up -> status REVOKED
member access is immediately denied post-revocation -> 403 access_denied
